_note: Aggregate numbers only, copied from research/AMAZON-CARRIER-DATA-DEEP-2026-09-25.md and research/RELAY-CARRIER-DISCRIMINATOR-2026-09-25.md (MEASURED against data.transportation.gov on 2026-09-24/25). No carrier names or DOT numbers. Rendered by tools/build-guides.mjs into /amazon-relay-carrier-data/ charts and CSV.

by-year.caption: Roadside inspections listing Amazon as shipper, by year
by-year.source: FMCSA Vehicle Inspection File (fx4q-ay7w), inspections where the shipper name contains AMAZON.

new-carriers.caption: Carriers seen with Amazon freight for the first time
new-carriers.source: FMCSA Vehicle Inspection File (fx4q-ay7w): carriers whose first Amazon-shipper inspection falls in the window.

states.caption: Carriers with an Amazon-shipper inspection since 2025-01-01, top 12 home states
states.source: Carrier physical state from the FMCSA Company Census (az4n-8mr2), joined on USDOT number.

fleet.caption: Fleet size (power units) of carriers with an Amazon-shipper inspection since 2025-01-01
fleet.source: FMCSA Company Census (az4n-8mr2) power units. This band query totals 19,355 carriers; read it as the shape of the distribution.

equipment.caption: Equipment that carriers hauling Amazon freight report owning
equipment.source: FMCSA Company Census (az4n-8mr2) equipment counts for 16,943 carriers with an Amazon-shipper inspection since 2025-01-01.

weight.caption: Vehicle weight class on Amazon-shipper inspections vs all other inspections
weight.source: FMCSA Vehicle Inspection File (fx4q-ay7w), gross_comb_veh_wt, populated on 100,499 of 101,444 Amazon-shipper inspections.

staying.caption: Share of carriers caught with Amazon freight again in the next six months, by how recently they were last seen with it
staying.source: FMCSA Vehicle Inspection File (fx4q-ay7w). Only carriers that were inspected at all between 2026-03-22 and 2026-09-22.
